task.title: Adding a Custom Permission to a Permission Set

step.cmd: In Salesforce, enter Permission Sets in Quick Search.
Click Permission Sets under Administration Setup.
Click on the name of an existing permission set or click New.
Under the list of Available Custom Permissions, click the name of a permission and then click Add to add it to the Enabled Custom Permissions list.

postreq.p: You can now assign the permission set to a specific user.
